preCommit.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$staged = git diff --cached --name-only; $skillsChanged = $staged | Where-Object { $_ -match '^skills/' }; $pluginChanged = $staged | Where-Object { $_ -match 'plugin\.json$' }; if ($skillsChanged -and -not $pluginChanged) { Write-Error 'Skills changed but .claude-plugin/plugin.json version was not bumped. Bump the version so plugin updates are detected.'; exit 1 }"
